 The primary 30-day driver was the Q1 2026 earnings release, where the company missed EPS estimates despite record revenue and net income. [...] Strong customer growth to over 135 million and AI-driven credit expansion provided some offset, but margin pressures dominated sentiment.
 Macro factors, including Brazilian interest rate dynamics and competitive intensity, amplified downside moves in the fintech sector. [...] The dominant catalyst was the May 14, 2026, release of Q1 2026 financial results. Nu Holdings reported record revenue surpassing $5 billion and net income of $871 million, up 41% year-over-year. However, GAAP EPS of $0.18 missed consensus estimates of $0.19-$0.20, triggering an immediate post-earnings decline of approximately 10% in after-hours trading.
